techniques.name: Real Person
techniques.desc: The face belongs to a real person

techniques.name: Synthetic Person
techniques.desc: The face is fully or partially generated

techniques.name: Non-Human
techniques.desc: A doll, mannequin, or other physical object

stages.description: How the attacker obtains or creates a selfie

techniques.name: No Change
techniques.desc: Using a photo, video, or live capture without modification.

techniques.name: Face Swap
techniques.desc: Swapping the target's face onto the attacker's face.

techniques.name: AI Image Generation
techniques.desc: Using AI to generate a face.

techniques.name: Phishing Flow
techniques.desc: Sending victims phishing links to fake identity verification flows to collect selfies and ID images.
subtechniques: Fake IDV flow that impersonates a real provider
Fake business that requests a selfie during onboarding

techniques.name: Unauthorized Access
techniques.desc: Using the identity of a nearby person, such as a friend, family member, or sleeping subject.

techniques.name: Identity Muling
techniques.desc: Having a real person verify their identity and then share the account credentials.

techniques.name: Masked Face
techniques.desc: Altering the subject using a wig, makeup, drawn-on facial hair, glasses, or other disguise.

stages.description: The attacker uses different techniques to alter the selfie and attempt to evade detection

techniques.name: No Refinement
techniques.desc: The content isn't refined any further.

techniques.name: Physical Occlusion
techniques.desc: The face is obscured with a physical object.

techniques.name: Physical Printing
techniques.desc: Printing an image or object that resembles a face.

techniques.name: Artifact Suppression
techniques.desc: Eliminating generation and fabrication artifacts that fraud detectors look for.

techniques.name: Noise Injection
techniques.desc: Adding characteristics of real camera capture, such as sensor noise and lens effects.

techniques.name: Compression Manipulation
techniques.desc: Exploiting lossy compression to destroy forensic traces.

techniques.name: Colour AND Lighting Matching
techniques.desc: Manipulating the color and lighting profile of the asset or physical environment to evade detection.

techniques.name: Resolution AND Format Matching
techniques.desc: Adjusting technical characteristics, such as resolution and format, to match expected device output.

techniques.name: Metadata Sanitization
techniques.desc: Removing or forging non-visual metadata that could reveal the fraud.

techniques.name: Geometric Transformation
techniques.desc: Applying small changes to an image in an attempt to evade hash-based detection.

techniques.name: Background Outpainting
techniques.desc: Generating or extending the background around the subject.

techniques.name: Face Inpainting
techniques.desc: Regenerating or replacing part of the face without changing the rest of the image.

stages.description: The attacker submits the selfie to the selfie verification request system.

techniques.name: Physical Presentation
techniques.desc: Holding a physical object in front of the camera.

techniques.name: Screen Replay
techniques.desc: Taking a picture or video of another screen that's displaying the selfie.

techniques.name: Virtual Camera Injection
techniques.desc: Intercepting the camera feed and substituting selfie content.

techniques.name: API / SDK Injection
techniques.desc: Submitting the content directly through or around the verification API or SDK.

techniques.name: Device Compromise
techniques.desc: Compromising the capture device to bypass integrity checks and camera API controls.

An unauthorized real-face asset is submitted through API or SDK injection.

A generated face receives several evasion refinements before injection.
